 This application coming on for admission this day, the c
 the following:
 Order

1. This is first application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure as applicant apprehends her arrest in connection with Crime No.28/2023 for the offences punishable under Sections 376(AB), 376(DB), 377 of IPC & Sections 5M and 6 of POCSO ACT 2012 registered at Police Station Katara Hills District Bhopal.

entities.text: Police Station Katara Hills District Bhopal
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. Counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is a woman and being falsely implicated in the case.
It is submitted that prosecution story and statement given by prosecutrix seems improbable.
It is very unlikely that wife will stand and laugh when husband is committing offending with the small girl child.
In these circumstances, applicant who is a woman may be enlarged on anticipatory bail.
3. Govt. Advocate for the State has opposed the bail application.

He read over the statement recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C.
